article.headline: Met Eireann issues Status Yellow fog warning for eight Irish counties tonight
article.summary: Met Eireann has issued a Status Yellow fog warning for eight counties, covering the period from 10pm Monday until 10am Tuesday.
article.body:
Temperatures are set to plummet to as low as -1C tonight, creating conditions where dense fog will likely become widespread. This overnight chill brings a risk of frost as skies remain mostly clear, leading to reduced visibility for anyone traveling across the affected regions.

Motorists should prepare for difficult driving conditions as the dense mist and fog are expected to persist through the early morning. With visibility significantly impacted, road safety is a primary concern for local authorities, and commuters are advised to exercise caution throughout the duration of the alert.

According to Met Eireann, the warning applies to counties Cavan, Donegal, and Monaghan, along with all of Connacht. While the fog is forecast to clear gradually throughout Tuesday morning, it may linger in some areas until the afternoon. The cold front is accompanied by near-calm conditions, which have prompted Donegal County Council to schedule gritting for all roads on its winter maintenance list starting at 6am on Tuesday, 3rd November.

Following the clearance of the fog and frost on Tuesday, the forecaster expects the conditions to improve as the day progresses. Residents in eastern and southern coastal areas may experience slightly milder weather compared to the inland regions, but the overall cold trend remains throughout the current 12-hour warning window.

news.title: Spanish Football Player Dies from Cardiac Arrest After Collision in Second-Division Match
news.og_title: Spanish Football Player Dies from Cardiac Arrest After Collision in Second-Division Match
news.og_desc: Tenerife forward Jesús de Miguel has died after he suffered cardiac arrest from an on-field collision in a Spanish second-division match, his club said Tuesday. He was 30. De Miguel was challenging for the ball during a game on Monday when he was struck in the chest by Andorra goalkeeper Jesús Owono during the final minutes at Estadio Heliodoro Rodríguez López. De Miguel was taken to a hospital and the match, tied 2-2, was suspended in the 108th minute.

news.title: US Strikes Iranian Island in the Strait of Hormuz
news.og_title: US Strikes Iranian Island in the Strait of Hormuz
news.og_desc: The United States launched limited strikes on an Iranian island in the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday, US media reported, as Iranian media reported five explosions in quick succession.  The reported strikes came as US voters prepared to cast their ballots in midterm elections that threaten President Donald Trump's grip on power.  The strikes, first reported by The Wall Street Journal, hit Qeshm Island, strategically located in the Hormuz waterway, a key flashpoint of the Middle East war that has upended global markets.
